note: PROTOTYPE — the lesson timeline's own key bindings, as data (architecture.md §5): change a key here, not in code. The player keys — Space, ← →, J K L — are every player's and live in @workspace/shared/navigation (David, 2026-10-29). Tab and Shift+Tab select a brick; - and = move it earlier or later (or drag it). P opens the selected brick in the brick editor, the same one the logger uses, to fix its edges; the lesson has no edge keys of its own (David, 2026-10-29). D sets the transition out of the selected brick into the next: cut or dissolve.
